name: Shoko Asahara (anonymous silhouette only)
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness. Shoko Asahara (convicted 2004, executed 2018) is drawn ONLY as an anonymous rim-lit silhouette (silhouette: 'warm'/'cool'): no face, no features, no colour and no photo reference; a generic shape (shoulder-length hair, beard, loose robe) only. Never posed heroically or in worship, never with followers bowing, never with any cult symbol, text or belief; never quoted. Shown small in a compound doorway and hunched in the cramped hidden space.
